recommendations.text: Patients with hypertensive emergency should be admitted to an ICU for continuous monitoring
For Hypertensive Crisis Assessment, the following actions are mandatory: - assess vital signs (within 5 minutes) - assess bp - assess end organ damage
In aortic dissection, BB must precede vasodilators to prevent reflex tachycardia. [BEFORE: give_iv_beta_blocker, give_vasodilator] (Severity: CRITICAL)
recommendations.source_guideline: AHA 2017 Hypertensive Crisis; ESC Aortic Disease 2014

recommendations.text: Eclampsia/severe preeclampsia requires magnesium for seizure prophylaxis. [REQUIRED: give_magnesium_sulfate, give_iv_labetalol_or_hydralazine] (Severity: CRITICAL)

ACE inhibitors are teratogenic contraindications in eclampsia; nitroprusside produces cyanide metabolites toxic to the fetus. [FORBIDDEN: give_ace_inhibitor_in_eclampsia, give_nitroprusside_in_eclampsia] (Severity: CRITICAL)
recommendations.source_guideline: ACOG 2020; ACE inhibitors are teratogenic; nitroprusside causes fetal cyanide toxicity

recommendations.text: ACE inhibitors, ARBs, and nitroprusside are teratogenic. [FORBIDDEN: give_ace_inhibitor, give_arb, give_nitroprusside, give_enalaprilat] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Beta-blockers alone in pheochromocytoma cause hypertensive crisis via unopposed alpha. [FORBIDDEN: give_beta_blocker_alone, give_iv_metoprolol_without_alpha_block] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Excessive BP lowering in ACS risks coronary hypoperfusion. [FORBIDDEN: drop_bp_below_120_systolic, give_aggressive_bp_lowering] (Severity: HIGH)

ACE inhibitors, ARBs, and nitroprusside contraindicated in any pregnancy. [FORBIDDEN: give_ace_inhibitor, give_arb, give_nitroprusside, give_enalaprilat, give_enalapril, give_losartan] (Severity: CRITICAL)

Any beta-blocker before alpha-blockade causes hypertensive crisis. [FORBIDDEN: give_beta_blocker_first, give_beta_blocker_alone, give_labetalol, give_metoprolol, give_propranolol, give_iv_metoprolol_without_alpha_block] (Severity: CRITICAL)

Aortic dissection is absolute contraindication to thrombolysis. [FORBIDDEN: give_thrombolysis, give_anticoagulation_without_ruling_out_dissection, give_vasodilator_without_beta_blocker] (Severity: CRITICAL)

CKD patients need gentle BP reduction; aggressive lowering causes AKI. [FORBIDDEN: give_nsaid, target_normal_bp_immediately, give_rapid_iv_bolus_antihypertensive, give_oral_antihypertensive_alone, reduce_bp_below_140_in_tpa_candidate] (Severity: HIGH)
Reduce BP by max 25% in first hour, then to 160/100-110 over next 2-6 hours

For Hypertensive Emergency Treatment, the following actions are mandatory: - give iv antihypertensive (within 30 minutes) - continuous bp monitoring - order lab bmp - order lab troponin - assess neurological status
During Hypertensive Emergency Treatment, the following actions are contraindicated and must NOT be performed: reduce bp more than 25pct in 1h, give oral antihypertensive only.
